g.text: Passive galvanic cells in a vented chamber - short cables <=30 cm - review draft

g.desc: Passive galvanic cells in a vented chamber - short cables <=30 cm - review draft

g.text: J402 is the owned SMB Male PCB connector. Verify its

g.text: land pattern and mating sensor plug before manufacture.

g.desc: land pattern and mating sensor plug before manufacture.

g.text: A disconnected/shorted cell can resemble 0% O2;

g.desc: A disconnected/shorted cell can resemble 0% O2;

g.text: calibration and plausibility checks are required.

g.desc: calibration and plausibility checks are required.

g.text: AIN0-AIN1 = O2 A; AIN2-AIN3 = O2 B.

g.desc: AIN0-AIN1 = O2 A; AIN2-AIN3 = O2 B.

g.text: Start at +/-0.256 V and 8 SPS; keep signed readings.

g.desc: Start at +/-0.256 V and 8 SPS; keep signed readings.

g.text: One ADC multiplexes the pairs; they are not simultaneous.

g.desc: One ADC multiplexes the pairs; they are not simultaneous.

g.text: No 50 ohm termination. No ground connection on SMB shell.

g.desc: No 50 ohm termination. No ground connection on SMB shell.

g.text: Check cell loading, reversed leads and power-off leakage

g.desc: Check cell loading, reversed leads and power-off leakage

g.text: with the actual sensors before accepting readings.

g.desc: with the actual sensors before accepting readings.

g.text: SMB shell = SENSE-. Insulate it from the enclosure and GND; no 50 ohm load.

g.desc: SMB shell = SENSE-. Insulate it from the enclosure and GND; no 50 ohm load.

g.text: PCB harness convention: 1 = SENSE+, 2 = SENSE-, 3 = spare/NC. Verify all AO2 cable pins before mating.

g.desc: PCB harness convention: 1 = SENSE+, 2 = SENSE-, 3 = spare/NC. Verify all AO2 cable pins before mating.

g.text: Place C407 at U401 VDD/GND. I2C pull-ups are on the host sheet.

g.desc: Place C407 at U401 VDD/GND. I2C pull-ups are on the host sheet.

g.text: He ADC AIN3 monitors this bias.
